$comment: Vercel resolves the filesystem before applying `rewrites`, so the
prerendered marketing pages (dist/product/index.html and friends, written
by prerender/prerender.mjs) are served as themselves, and so are
robots.txt and sitemap.xml. The catch-all below only picks up the
authenticated client-side routes. The negative lookahead excludes them
explicitly anyway, because this is the one thing that must not regress:
those files are the entire site as far as GPTBot, ClaudeBot and
PerplexityBot are concerned, none of which run JavaScript.
